title: kb.entry.superseded v1
description: Emitted by `kb supersede` (kb/src/commands/supersede.rs) after the target entry has been marked superseded and, when locally resolvable, its replacement has been linked back. The CloudEvents-lite envelope is produced by kb/src/bus.rs with source `/kb`; this schema validates its `data` object only. `superseded_by` is intentionally a nonempty reference rather than a UUID: the producer permits a replacement outside the local vault and preserves the raw `--by` argument in that case. No dedicated consumer is evidenced by the current exact-channel source scan, so this is currently write-only telemetry.

entry_id.description: UUID of the vault entry that was marked superseded.

superseded_by.description: Replacement entry reference: its UUID when locally resolved, otherwise the raw external `--by` reference.

reason.description: Free-form supersession reason supplied by the command, or its `superseded` default.

file.description: Path to the superseded vault markdown entry.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp recorded by the emitter after the write completes.
